summary: Spark 3.5 runs with spark.sql.ansi.enabled=false by default; Krishiv runs the 4.2 default (ANSI on) on every set, so lenient casts, coercions and parses raise instead. Only files run with the default setting count: the ansi/* files and postgreSQL/interval run with ANSI on in Spark 3.5 too, so their failures are something else
